name: staff-role-list-permission-fix
title: Fix employee modal role list authorization
description: Make legacy role checks honor inherited parent roles so authorized restaurant-management accounts can load authoritative staff roles.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The selected restaurant reaches the modal correctly. Step-one validation blocks because roleList is rejected before createStaff runs. The authenticated role is populated with parentRole, but the shared legacy hasRole helper ignored that inherited management role. The helper now evaluates parentRole slug/name and has a focused regression test. Targeted tests and builds were not run because the connector environment has no runnable repository checkout.
